episodes.title: First Kiss
episodes.summary: Under pressure from her parents to swap her blood pills for the real thing, Juliette sets her sights on new girl Cal, who has her own family stress.

episodes.title: First Blood
episodes.summary: The shocking aftermath of Noah's party sparks more questions than answers. Juliette's mother jumps to conclusions. A monster zeroes in on Cal's family.

episodes.title: First Fight
episodes.summary: Juliette bites off more than she can chew ahead of her big night, while Cal feels a knot of unease as her family prepares for a risky vampire hunt.

episodes.title: First Date
episodes.summary: Juliette and Cal contend with a common enemy amid the chaos of the consecration ceremony as sides are chosen, deals are made and milestones reached.

episodes.title: First Love
episodes.summary: Cal and Juliette have a heart-to-heart after seeking a safe haven. A strange threat stalks the school. Negotiations over Elinor's future turn cutthroat.

episodes.title: First Severing
episodes.summary: Efforts to keep Juliette and Cal apart escalate as their wary families reach a mutual understanding during a murder investigation.

episodes.title: First Goodbye
episodes.summary: Rising tensions in Savannah put Cal and Juliette in jeopardy. Theo digs for information about his past before joining Apollo on an ill-fated mission.

episodes.title: First Betrayal
episodes.summary: Blood flows and betrayal burns after a shocking turn of events leaves devastation in its wake — and tests the bonds of love between Cal and Juliette.
